mapper.select: /** [sql-recycle.xml] RecycleMapper.getMf17Info **/ SELECT MF17.MF17_NO , MF17.MF17_CODE , CM08_NAME AS MF17_NAME , MF17.MF17_PCC FROM TB_MF_17 MF17 ,TB_CM_08 CM08 WHERE 1=1 AND MF17.MF17_COMPANY = CM08.CM08_COMPANY AND MF17.MF17_FACTORY = CM08.CM08_FACTORY AND MF17.MF17_CODE = CM08.CM08_CODE AND MF17.MF17_COMPANY = #{st12Company} AND MF17.MF17_FACTORY = #{st12Factory} AND MF17.MF17_QR = #{st12Qr}
